answer: Give the epoch a backbone: Copperplate engraver seal matrix warrant engraved into the print room, proved by each seal matrix is a measured plate yield plus an engraver signature, checked by strangers. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is checked against an open register. Time is the toll no farm can skip: 11 minutes per proof, 4147 minutes for 377, due every single epoch. Take the plume away and the name goes; take the anchor away and the stake goes; take the walnut away and the past goes. The epoch is a market where proofs are the coin, and the farm arrived with counterfeits.
